inputs.label: No One Lives Forever game archives
inputs.help: From your own NOLF PC copy. On the original discs, Disc 1 Data has NOLF2.REZ, nolfu003.rez and nolfu003cres.rez, and Disc 2 Data has NOLF.REZ.

inputs.label: GOTY bonus chapter (optional)
inputs.help: NOLFGOTY.REZ from a Game of the Year copy adds the Rest and Relaxation chapter.

steps.text: If ReLith 0.3.1 or older is installed, back up /sdcard/nolf/Save and /sdcard/nolf/autoexec.cfg, then uninstall it first. Version 0.4.0 has a new signing key and cannot install over it.

steps.why: The guide says the first launch must grant All files access so the game reads /sdcard/nolf/.

steps.text: Open ReLith from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for access to manage all files, allow it. You should get the main menu.

notes: The newest release (v0.4.1) has only a Windows build; qgp skips releases without a matching asset and picks v0.4.0. The 0.3.1 to 0.4.0 signing change needs a backup, uninstall and restore; qgp cannot do the backup yet, so a tell step warns. Files on /sdcard keep their exact case (NOLF.REZ, nolfu003.rez). FontData.fnt is optional and not modelled. Do not copy MODERNIZER; it is in the APK.
